# Life Ledger · Deep Review 2.0.1

A fix release for 2.0.0.

## Fixed

- **Browsers that had used 1.x could freeze on their first 2.0 visit.** The 1.x/2.0.0 service worker reloaded open pages while it was still activating, and the reload waited for that same activation to finish. 2.0.1 reloads pages onto the new release only after activation, so upgrades complete on their own. (A browser that already froze recovers after closing the tab once.)
- **The local edition shows the three-month sample to every visitor again.** 2.0.0 skipped the sample for anyone who had used the local edition before. Now everyone sees it; records you made earlier in that browser are kept in a backup and come back with **Settings → Restore earlier records**.

## Unchanged

- Cloud edition data, sync, photos and Google Calendar; no migration.

## Roll back

See [2.0.0 → Roll back to 1.3](v2.0.0.md#roll-back-to-13). Tag `v2.0.0` and `v1.3.0` both stay available.
